blurb: Guests rent deck boats with fiberglass bottoms for up to 10 people, suitable for parties and exploring local waters. They can hire licensed USCG captains for various activities including fishing, snorkeling, and tours. The service area includes Bradenton, Sarasota, Anna Maria Island, Siesta Key, Lido Key, Homes Beach, Ellenton, Palmetto, Bradenton Beach, and Longboat Key.
